criteria_string: {"components":[{"criterion":"The view reads from below the standing subject rather than eye-level or above, through the underside of the chin and overhead bench/roof geometry.","id":"below_subject_projection","required":true},{"criterion":"Upward-facing projection includes overhead roof ribs and a clear view of architectural undersides.","id":"upward_projection","required":true},{"criterion":"Nearby boots/lower body are visibly enlarged relative to the receding upper body/head in the same connected subject.","id":"near_lower_scale","required":true},{"criterion":"Multiple vertical iron columns recede and converge toward the upper frame; this is coherent spatial perspective, not isolated leaning props.","id":"upward_convergence","required":true}],"confusion_boundaries":["A Dutch roll or diagonal frame alone does not show low angle.","A level full-body photograph with tall background alone fails.","A wide lens alone without upward projection fails.","A subject on a raised platform does not itself prove a low camera.","Numerical camera height cannot be measured from this image; only apparent position and projection are judged."],"evidence_units":"visible regions and relationships at native size and reduced view","keyword":"로우 앵글","rule":"all_of; partial_is_fail"}
